title: Minimum Carlitz rank of an APN permutation
summary: Determine the smallest field size and Carlitz rank for which an APN permutation polynomial exists over a binary finite field.

formal_statement.body: Let $q=2^n>5$. Determine the minimum feasible field size $q$ and the minimum feasible Carlitz rank $k$ among APN permutation polynomials $G:\mathbb F_q\to\mathbb F_q$ with $\operatorname{Crk}(G)=k$. The source does not impose a lexicographic order on the pair $(q,k)$; settle both minima by construction or impossibility results for smaller values.

scope.domain: APN permutation polynomials over binary finite fields and their Carlitz rank
assumptions: G is an APN permutation polynomial over F_q
scope.unresolved_remainder: The source reports only lower bounds and sporadic constructions; the minimum feasible q and minimum feasible k are not jointly determined by later inspected literature.
